title: Pricing page: rental memberships
content:
Rental plans. Compare three plans.

Plans:
- Day Pass: $0 a month; pay per rental; members get 20% off. Button: Rent now.
- Weekender: $19 a month; 2 rentals a month included; free gear delivery. Button: Choose Weekender. (Most popular)
- Season Pass: $49 a month; unlimited rentals; priority booking for kayaks; free delivery. Button: Choose Season Pass.

Comparison of features (rows) by plan (columns):
- Included rentals: none, 2 per month, unlimited
- Member discount: 20%, 20%, 20%
- Free delivery: no, yes, yes
- Priority kayak booking: no, no, yes

Note: Prices include tax. Cancel any time.
